links.outcome: Post-hoc verification of generated SQL: answerability classification versus SQL error correction
links.effect: Benchmarked post-hoc verification methods, from two-stage to agentic, showed a critical trade-off between question classification and SQL error correction. No numeric results are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Our experiments reveal a critical trade-off between question classification and SQL error correction, highlighting key challenges and outlining directions for future research.
